summary: Iteration 18 executed both backend and frontend retest on public preview URL. Backend smoke for auth identity, shop access guards, and coach history isolation passed 4/4. Frontend critical identity path passed: Chef->logout->Nonna->logout->Chef in same browser, Nonna saw €4.99 offer with no identity error and no inherited entitlement, Chef regained entitlement and sent a unique Coach prompt with new response flow. No 'Unexpected text node' runtime warning was observed in this run. Course UI flow was partially validated (creator draft+submit and student unauthorized-admin guard), but full creator->admin publish->student follow/progress path could not be completed due unreliable admin fixture session automation in web preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Token-only disposable admin fixture session was not reliably retained by Expo web auth hydration; login screen frequently reappeared after injection, blocking deterministic admin publish/payout modal checks.

integration_issues.issue: Creator draft creation and submit succeeded, but admin publish/payout UI verification was incomplete; student catalogue did not show the new fixture course (course remained not verifiably published through UI in this run).

action_items: Main agent: provide a deterministic admin UI test path without relying on Google interactive auth (or provide a first-class fixture-login route for verified admin in preview) to complete publish + payout modal UI assertions.

Main agent: after admin-path stabilization, retest full course flow end-to-end (creator submit -> admin publish -> student follow preview -> mark complete -> my-courses progress, and locked lesson remains unreadable).
Main agent: keep validating with :visible selectors due Expo Router hidden-screen retention across account switches.
critical_code_review_comments: CoachOffer text-node regression appears fixed: no 'Unexpected text node' warning found across current purchase/switch/coach retest logs.
Identity queue behavior looked correct in UI logs: account binding moved Chef -> Nonna -> Chef with stable backend-style user IDs and no Nonna identity error on offer screen.
Backend pytest conftest hard-fails when EXPO_BACKEND_URL/EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is not exported in shell; CI/test runners should ensure env is injected consistently.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (critical identity/coach/revenuecat checks passed; course-admin UI E2E incomplete)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated temporary fixture set (creator/student/admin session + earning) via /app/tests/setup_iter18_fixtures.py, used for UI checks, then cleaned with /app/tests/cleanup_iter18_fixtures.py including credentials note cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Critical identity retest is green: Chef purchase/restore and coach send worked, Nonna stayed unsubscribed with €4.99 offer and no identity error, and no text-node runtime warning appeared. Remaining gap is admin UI automation for publish/payout under preview auth constraints; continue from a deterministic admin-auth test strategy then re-run student course consumption assertions.
rca_of_issue: RCA for incomplete course E2E: UI automation could not reliably establish a persistent verified-admin shell with token-only fixture in Expo web preview. Evidence: backend logs show creator submit endpoint 200 and admin token valid in direct API checks, but admin UI steps intermittently returned to login or showed no actionable admin rows; API /api/admin/shop calls were not consistently hit during failing attempts. Mitigation: introduce deterministic preview-safe admin fixture sign-in flow (or controlled test-only session exchange) and then re-run admin publish/payout modal + downstream student course progress checks.
